integrity: The displayed count and rank are all-parameter claims established by the included proof; finite checker results corroborate, not prove, them.
scientific_limitations: Only finite complete height-two posets with both nonempty levels in the pure bounded Heyting signature; independent historical priority is not established. The source arXiv:2610.23399v1 motivates poset enumeration; it is not asserted to contain the theorem.
title: Exact generator census and a singleton-layer phase change in two-level Heyting algebras
